description: Search ClinicalTrials.gov by free text, intervention or condition; status ongoing | completed | all; sort relevance | newest | largest | completion. Returns the total and up to 100 rows as arrays in columns order: NCT ID, title, status, phase, enrollment ("~100" estimated), start, primary completion, primary outcome, conditions, interventions, has_results. Link: https://clinicaltrials.gov/study/<NCT ID>. Cached 7 days. One trial in detail: library_clinicaltrials_get_study_record.

intervention.description: Intervention or treatment, e.g. "tadalafil", "cognitive behavioral therapy".

query.description: Free-text search across all fields (title, conditions, interventions, summary, …); AND / OR / NOT allowed.

sort.description: relevance (the registry's ranking), newest (last update first), largest (enrollment first), completion (completion date, latest first).

status.description: ongoing: recruiting, not yet recruiting, active not recruiting, enrolling by invitation. completed: completed. all: no filter.

name: library_clinicaltrials_search_studies
